parent_v10.key_result: four hand-designed transition topologies with identical A/B/M/G and marginal maps differed in relation, first-passage and intervention targets in 192/192 replicates

parent_v11.key_result: narrow relational targets could be resolved with one or two measurements, while the combined relational suite became topology-identifying

scientific_question: Does static nodewise equivalence continue to hide substantial topology-sensitive ecological variation when transition graphs are randomly generated rather than chosen as chain/star/tree archetypes?

panel.static_state: A and B permissive at all nodes; M and G equal to the same active-node mask in every topology world; continuous nodewise marginal-score vector fixed within row

random_topology_generator.active_label_order: one response-independent shuffled active-node label set per row with source S fixed
random_topology_generator.per_world_topological_order: independent deterministic permutation of non-source active nodes with S first
random_topology_generator.reachability_backbone: for each non-source node in topological order, choose one parent uniformly from earlier nodes, creating a rooted arborescence and guaranteeing identical M accessibility
random_topology_generator.extra_edges: each absent forward edge consistent with the world-specific topological order is added independently using the frozen extra-edge probability
random_topology_generator.duplicate_edge_topology: if duplicate edge sets occur within a row, retain them and report the duplicate count rather than regenerating after scoring

targets.intervention: reachable-active-node count after each non-source node knockout
targets.critical_node_count: number of non-source nodes whose removal disconnects at least one additional active node

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: All 12 topology worlds in every row share one identical A/B/M/G/marginal representation.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least 95 percent of rows contain more than one pairwise-relation target class.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the eligible-row fraction is <0.95.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least 95 percent of rows contain more than one first-passage target class.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the eligible-row fraction is <0.95.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least 95 percent of rows contain more than one intervention target class.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the eligible-row fraction is <0.95.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across all generated worlds, Spearman correlation between edge count and mean single-node-knockout retained fraction is strictly positive.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the pooled Spearman correlation is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across all generated worlds, Spearman correlation between edge count and mean source first-passage depth is strictly negative.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the pooled Spearman correlation is >=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least half of rows have non-identical equivalence partitions for pairwise relation, first-passage and intervention targets.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if fewer than 50 percent of rows show target-partition disagreement.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: No row has only one distinct edge-topology identity while all 12 worlds share the complete static G mask; rows with duplicate random edge sets are allowed, but every row must retain at least two distinct edge topologies.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if any row collapses to one edge topology.

secondary_outputs: distinct topology and target-class count distributions
target quotient compression ratios relative to distinct edge topology count
frequency of duplicate random edge topologies
claim_boundary: The random DAG generator is a controlled topology ensemble, not a fitted dispersal model.
Pooled correlations are generator-level structural associations, not empirical ecological effect sizes.
Static equivalence is imposed by construction to test information sufficiency.
The 95-percent generality thresholds are preregistered for this frozen ensemble only.
stop_rules: Do not change the 95-percent thresholds after scoring.
Do not change the extra-edge schedule after scoring.
Do not regenerate duplicate worlds after seeing target results.
Do not drop active-node sizes that weaken a hypothesis.
